verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source classification and acquisition review. Preserve uncertainty and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Final Flash (SS3 DAIMA) — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.method: Cross-checked the dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill documentation and independent Parallel Quest reward documentation. The DAIMA variant is kept distinct from Final Flash (Ultimate) and Final Flash (Super).
verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Final Flash (SS3 DAIMA) as a Ki Blast Ultimate used by SS3 Vegeta (DAIMA), with a base cost of 400 Ki and an extendable remaining-Ki mechanic.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The skill is listed as a reward from Parallel Quest 181 — The Greatest Training Ever, part of the Dragon Ball DAIMA Pack.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the reviewed sources establish the PQ reward but do not establish an Ultimate Finish-only acquisition requirement.
verification_audit.variant_policy: The DAIMA variant is kept separate from Final Flash (Ultimate), Final Flash (Super), Revenge Final Flash, and other Final Flash variants.
verification_audit.damage_policy: No fixed canonical damage value is recorded because reported damage depends on remaining Ki, character/build conditions, and version-sensitive mechanics.

records.name: Final Flash (SS3 DAIMA)
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 181 — The Greatest Training Ever
records.skill_description: Charge and fire a full-power Final Flash; holding the input after the initial requirement can spend the user's remaining Ki to extend the beam and increase its power.
records.mechanics_notes: The dedicated skill documentation describes a two-handed electrified beam, categorized as beam and extendable, with 22–53 hits. The initial requirement is 400 Ki; continued input while above the initial requirement spends remaining Ki for an additional power boost.
